stories.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro, Brazil’s defeated presidential candidate and a senator, arrived in Florida with his family after losing the election to incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. links.headline: Female bookkeeper nabbed, P183K ‘shabu’ seized in Pagadian
links.excerpt: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — Anti-narcotics operatives arrested a 47-year-old bookkeeper after seizing nearly P184,000 worth of illegal drugs and live ammunition. The apprehension and the seizure happened during an entrapment operation in Barangay Tiguma, Pagadian City, Tuesday night, October 27. stories.title: AI-driven disinformation running rampant on social media before US midterms, experts warn
stories.summary: Experts warn that social-media feeds are carrying an unprecedented volume of AI-generated disinformation ahead of November’s US midterm elections. They say many deceptive posts are likely evading safeguards as companies including Meta scale back efforts to protect voters from election-related falsehoods.
